_comment: API endpoint paths (relative to apiBaseUrl in the active environment file). These are placeholders — confirm/replace once backend integration details are provided. ApiTicketRepository reads these so endpoint changes need no code edits.

auth._comment_commonLogin: SM-Partners directory lookup — step 1 of login, called the moment the agent submits their mobile number. Lives on its own host, so it carries an ABSOLUTE URL (used verbatim: no apiBaseUrl prefix, no agentId param). `appName` is fixed per app and travels in the URL; ApiTicketRepository appends `userMobilenumber`. A success (status 200 with a `data` block) gates the OTP send; the returned `data` is the real agent record.

agent._comment_location: Reports the agent's current device coordinates. Body: {agentId, lat, lng}. Fired every time the Field Agent lands on the home screen — first open, returning from a pushed screen, switching back to the Tasks tab, and app resume — plus a periodic heartbeat every `location.reportIntervalMinutes` (app_config.json, default 5) for as long as the app stays in the foreground. Skipped when there is no GPS fix.
agent._comment_route: The agent's server-planned route for the shift. Response: {agentId, agentName, stops:[{ticketId, ticketNumber, customerName, sequence, lat, lng, legDistanceKm}], totalDistanceKm}. Called every time the agent opens the Map tab. The backend owns the ordering — the app plots `stops` in `sequence` order and draws the drive from the agent's current position through each of them.

attempts._comment_submit: Standalone attempts service on its own host. Carries an ABSOLUTE URL so ApiClient uses it verbatim — no apiBaseUrl prefix and no agentId query param (the contract accepts no query params). Called on Submit Attempt from the Update Status screen.

customer._comment_updateDetails: Customers service on the same host as the attempts service, so these carry ABSOLUTE URLs — ApiClient sends them verbatim with no apiBaseUrl prefix and no agentId query param. Called on Save from the Visit Customer Address screen to patch the address components + alternate number the agent entered, and on Save from the Call Customer screen to patch the updated mobile the agent entered (sent as `phoneSecondary`, with the address fields left null). Prefer `updateById` ({id} = the ticket detail's customer.id): phone numbers are NOT unique in this backend and `updateByPhone` answers 409 'Ambiguous phonePrimary' whenever several customers share one. `updateByPhone` is only the fallback for a ticket detail that carried no customer id.

audit._comment: Platform audit log. Lives on the shared app API, NOT on apiBaseUrl — the host differs per environment, so it is resolved against `auditLogBaseUrl` from the active environment file (prod: https://smartnetwork.azure-api.net/app/api/v1, dev: https://smartnetwork-dev.azure-api.net/app-staging/api/v1) instead of being written as an absolute URL here. Body = AuditEvent.toJson (transactionId, userId, userName, activityStartDate, activityEndDate, userActivity, appName, appVersion, status, activityContext). activityStartDate/activityEndDate are non-nullable Int64 epoch milliseconds — an ISO string or a null is rejected with a 400.

battery._comment: Battery Master API lives on its own host (different base URL than apiBaseUrl), so this endpoint carries an ABSOLUTE URL. ApiClient uses absolute endpoint URLs verbatim (no apiBaseUrl prefix, no agentId param) while still attaching the Bearer token. {bpId} is filled from the ticket's bpId.
